deviations.what: The sample's AnalyticalTable declares its row mode through the rowMode aggregation with a sap.ui.table.rowmodes.Auto instance - both the aggregation (sap.ui.table.Table.rowMode) and the control (sap.ui.table.rowmodes.Auto) are @since 1.119, i.e. newer than the 1.71 floor. Kept 1:1 per the fidelity-first policy (AGENTS §5), same as app 164 (the RowModes sample) which declares the same aggregation; the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.119 to render the table at its intended row height. The pre-1.119 alternative (visibleRowCountMode='Auto' + rowHeight) is a different, deprecated API and would not be the sample.
